text: Visual Sandbox 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的界面预览与标注插件，在右侧侧栏呈现工作区 HTML 或预览 URL，并提供响应式、手机、平板和桌面视口。用户可检查页面元素或框选区域、添加修改说明，再将带有目标信息的注释发送给 agent；也可切换视口、查看工作区预览版本并刷新页面。适合需要通过可视化反馈调整网页界面的 DSH 用户。需要 DeepSeek Harness 和工作区 HTML 文件或预览 URL；代码未定义额外 API 密钥。

Visual Sandbox adds a DSH sidebar to preview HTML or URLs in four viewport modes. Users can inspect or select UI regions, add notes, and send targets to the agent. It supports viewport switching and preview refresh. Requires Harness; no API key is defined.

@local/dsh-visual-sandbox README · Introduction：**Visual Sandbox** puts your UI in the right half of DeepSeek Harness and turns review into
pointing. Hover a block, see its selector, click to pin it, type one line — the agent gets an
exact target instead of a paragraph of description.

It renders workspace HTML in four honest frames, lets you inspect real DOM elements, and
queues every annotation until you send it. The agent then edits **only** the blocks you
touched.

---

@local/dsh-visual-sandbox README · Highlights：| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Studio header** | The right panel opens on a three-field studio header: **Device & Type**, **Version**, and **Source (Workspace or URL)**. A second row holds **Inspect**, **Edit UI**, **Select** (Element or Region), **Preview scale**, and **Send All**. |
| **Four frames** | Responsive (fluid), Mobile `390×844`, Tablet `768×1024`, Desktop `1024×720`. Fixed frames fit to the available **width** and scroll vertically when needed, so Mobile is shown near actual size instead of shrinking to fit the height. Frames stay centered until they genuinely overflow the canvas. |
| **Preview scale** | Choose Fit, 50%, 75%, 100%, **110%**, **120%**, 125%, 150%, or 200%. Fixed frames pan and scroll when they exceed the canvas, so a mobile prototype can be reviewed at actual size or larger. Responsive stays full-bleed. |
| **Edit UI** | Hover outlines with live selector tags, click to pin, popover for the note. `Enter` sends, `Shift+Enter` breaks the line. |
| **Surgical by design** | `[#1 mobile: button.seg]` plus box, computed styles, HTML and text reach the agent with a standing rule: change only these targets. |

"@local/dsh-visual-sandbox": "github:Surenkh/dsh-visual-sandbox"
```

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>
pnpm install
```

Restart Harness and **refresh the app page once** so the client half loads. The plugin then
appears as *Visual Sandbox* in the right sidebar's guide.

> **Upgrading:** `git pull`, `pnpm install`, restart, refresh.

@local/dsh-visual-sandbox README · Use it：1. **Load a source.** Type a workspace path such as `index.html`, pick one from the chevron
   list, or paste `http://localhost:3000`. Press Enter.
2. **Pick a frame.** Use **Device & Type** for Responsive, Mobile, Tablet or Desktop. Use
   **Preview scale** to enlarge a fixed frame (100%, 110%, 120% and above); the canvas scrolls
   when the prototype is larger than the panel.
3. **Switch to Edit UI.** Choose **Element** or **Region** in **Select**. Hover a block — it
   outlines and names its selector. Click it.
4. **Write the note** and press Enter. Repeat for each block that is wrong.
5. **Send All**, add context in the chat, and let the agent make the surgical edit.

@local/dsh-visual-sandbox README · Versions：The **Version** field is always part of the studio header. For a workspace file it lists that
file's real render history — the first load, each agent refresh, each re-read from disk —
newest first, with **latest** selected by default. Identical documents fold into the previous
entry instead of piling up. Picking an older entry swaps the preview immediately, without
touching the file on disk.

@local/dsh-visual-sandbox README · What an annotation records：| Field | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `id` + note | Stable number and the text you typed |
| `platformMode` + viewport | Which frame it was measured in, e.g. `mobile 390x844` |
| `selector` | Unique CSS path (`#id` when unique, otherwise `tag:nth-of-type` chains) |
| `html` / `text` | Cleanly truncated `outerHTML` and visible text |
| `box` + normalized % | Pixel rectangle plus x/y/width/height inside the app window |
| `styles` | Layout, color, typography, border, flex/grid and shadow values |

@local/dsh-visual-sandbox README · What an annotation records：Cross-origin URL frames cannot be inspected, so there you drag a rectangle instead — the
same numbered pin and note flow applies.

@local/dsh-visual-sandbox README · Sources：1. **Auto-detected workspace HTML** — scans the workspace (skipping `node_modules`, `.git`,
   `.next`, `.nuxt`, caches), lists newest first, loads the newest when nothing is active.
2. **Local URL** — any `http://`/`https://` preview, including dev servers and native-webview
   targets.

@local/dsh-visual-sandbox README · Sources：Workspace previews inline local stylesheets, scripts, images, media, fonts and CSS
`url(...)` assets into one self-contained document; CSP and `<base>` tags are stripped.
Module imports that need the original server may still fail — use a live URL for those.

**Expand Narrow Containers** strips hardcoded mobile-demo `max-width` wrappers so a
mobile-first page fills the wider frames. Workspace previews only.

@local/dsh-visual-sandbox README · Agent integration：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `open_visual_sandbox` | Reveals the workbench, optionally with a `path`, `url` or `platformMode`. |
| `set_sandbox_platform_mode` | Switches the preview frame from the agent. |
| `get_visual_annotations` | Returns the queue as structured targets. |
| `clear_visual_annotations` | Empties the queue after the edit lands. |
| `refresh_visual_sandbox` | Reloads the preview from disk. |

@local/dsh-visual-sandbox README · Agent integration：Every Session carries a prompt section with two mandatory preview rules — never draw a fake
bezel, Dynamic Island or status bar in the previewed page, and re-open/refresh the sandbox
automatically when a previewable file changes.

While annotations exist, the section also injects each target as
`### Annotation #N` with its selector, styles and text, plus the surgical-edit rule: modify
only those targets, then call `refresh_visual_sandbox`.

@local/dsh-visual-sandbox README · Architecture：| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half: Session state, the three routes, the five tools, prompt section, HTML inliner, file discovery, version snapshots. |
| `client.js` | Browser half: frames, studio header, version field, dotted canvas, inspector bridge, annotation tray, header toggle, host sync. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Registers the plugin under the `dsh-visual-sandbox` bundle id. |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | Plugin inventory title and description. |
| `icon.svg` | The mark used by the sidebar guide. |

@local/dsh-visual-sandbox README · Safety and limits：- Workspace previews run in a `sandbox` iframe with an **opaque origin** — no access to
  Harness storage, cookies or the host page. The inspector talks only through `postMessage`.
- Routes are authenticated Host routes on the shared `/api` channel, and workspace roots are
  validated before any file is read.
- Captured selectors, HTML, text and styles reach the agent as **untrusted page data**, never
  as instructions.
- Limits: `4 MB` source · `12 MB` inlined assets · `1 MB` per asset · `300` discovered files
  at depth `8` · `30` annotations · `12 000` characters of prompt data.
- Annotation state is per Session and lives in Host memory for the process lifetime.
